Description:
[b][color=#f4cccc][size=5]H[/size][/color][color=#f4cccc][size=4]ello! :D[/size][/color][/b]

Inspired by Don's portrait, I wanted to draw pixel art. thank you! :)

[color=#c9daf8][b][size=5]M[/size][size=4]anual :3[/size][/b][/color]
[b]- All items cannot be used together with [color=#ea9999][size=3]seasonal costumes[/size][/color]. Please give up on either one.[/b]

[b] ﻿+﻿[color=#fce5cd]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong ([size=1]CP[/size]) [/color]:[/b]
﻿ 1. Install the latest versions of SMAPI and ContentPatcher.
﻿ 2. Unzip [CP] Nyapu's Portraits into your Mods folder.
﻿ 3. Launch StardewModing API and play.

[b]﻿+[color=#fce5cd](CP) Nyapu'sP(SVE) [/color]:[/b]
﻿ 1. Install the latest versions of SMAPI and ContentPatcher and Stardew Valley Expanded.
﻿ 2. Unzip (CP) Nyapu'sP(SVE) into your Mods folder.
﻿ 3. Launch StardewModing API and play.

[b]+[color=#d8d8d8]Nyapu's Portraits inspired by Dong ([/color][size=1]XNB[/size][color=#d8d8d8]) :[/color][/b] [color=#e06666][b][size=1] [/size][size=1]!! It may damage the game. I don't recommend it unless you're used to it. !! [/size][/b][/color]
 ﻿1. Back up the Stardew Valley / Content / Portraits folder.
  ﻿2. Unzip Nyapu's portrait/portrait into Stardew Valley/Content folder.
  ﻿3. Let's play Stardew Valley!

- Other cover versions are just data. [b]Even if you put the Nyapu's folder in the Mods folder, it will not work.[/b]
- If installation fails, SMAPI may issue an error regarding an empty file.
[color=#f4cccc]- These files were not designed with [/color][b]Vortex[/b][color=#f4cccc] in mind.[/color]
[b]+[/b][color=#b6d7a8]﻿[b]Nyapu's Portraits(~) or Nyapu's P(~) [/b][/color][b][color=#b6d7a8]:[/color] [color=#e06666][size=1]!! If you just put it in the Mods folder, you'll get an error saying it's an empty folder. !! [/size][/color][/b]
﻿ 1. Install a supported version of the original MOD and check for startup errors.
﻿ 2. Unzip "Nyapu's Portraits(~)" or "Nyapu's P(~)".[b] Use the folder inside this instead of leaving it as is.[/b]
[size=2] ﻿﻿ 3. Overwrite the folder inside with the same name folder of the original MOD.
﻿ ﻿4. Launch StardewModing API and play.
[/size][size=2]
